strings.menu.title: Main menu
strings.menu.prompt: What would you like to do?
strings.settings.delete_confirm_prompt: This will permanently delete all your data: profile, pairs, answers, and purchases. This cannot be undone.
strings.settings.deleted: Account deleted. Send /start to start fresh.
strings.onboarding.name: What should I call you?
strings.onboarding.mature: Do you want direct 18+ cards to appear in your shared deck?
strings.pair.instructions:
Pair

Send your partner's @username, Telegram numeric ID, a manually shared contact, or an invite link.
strings.pair.open_first: Open Pair first, then send a contact, username, or ID.
strings.pair.invalid_identifier: I couldn't read that. Send @username, numeric Telegram ID, a manually shared contact, or an invite link.
strings.pair.request_sent: Pair request created. I tried to notify your partner. Invite link: %s
strings.pair.invite_created: Pair request created. Send this invite to your partner: %s
strings.pair.incoming: %s invited you to pair in WRNRS.
strings.pair.accept_prompt: Pair request found. Accept it to bind your accounts.
strings.pair.accepted: Pair accepted. You can start the game now.
strings.pair.already_paired: One of you already has an active pair.
strings.pair.not_found: This pair request is expired or unavailable.
strings.pair.error: Pairing failed. Try again from Pair.
strings.game.not_ready: Pair setup and card deck are not ready yet.
strings.game.answer_prompt: Write your answer in one message. It will be available for reveal after both partners complete the card.
strings.game.answer_empty: The answer cannot be empty. Write an answer or tap Skip.
strings.game.answer_saved_demo: Answer saved. It reveals after your partner completes the card.
strings.game.paused: Game paused. You can return through Start / Resume.
strings.game.card_stale: This button is stale. Open the current card from the main menu.
strings.game.invite_sent: Game invite sent to your partner.
strings.game.invite_incoming: %s wants to start the next card with you.
strings.game.invite_expired: This game invite expired. Start again when you are both ready.
strings.game.waiting_partner: Answer saved. Waiting for your partner.
strings.payments.success: Premium unlocked. Thank you for supporting the project.
strings.payments.support: For payment or refund support, contact the author with your Telegram ID and payment date.
strings.game.requires_pair: An active pair is required to play. Tap "Pair" to invite someone.
strings.payments.premium_desc: Lifetime premium access, all current cosmetics, and no support prompts.
